reason: Old GetAsync/DeleteAsync methods are kept (marked Obsolete) with restored name-based semantics for backward compatibility while callers move to new FindById/FindByName/DeleteById/DeleteByName APIs, reducing breakage though external code relying on the previous id-based GetAsync/DeleteAsync signatures introduced pre-release would now silently behave differently (name lookup vs id lookup).
